ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: given a seat
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has spoken up more since the colony made {PAWN_objective} its {LABEL}.

plain.li: They chose me as {LABEL}. I keep looking round to see who they meant.
So I'm {LABEL} now. I've a list of things to put right already, and I've only been at it an hour.
I went for a walk after the vote to think about being {LABEL}. I came back with more questions than I left with.
[persona:proud] They made me {LABEL}. About time somebody noticed.

warm.li: The colony trusts me enough to make me {LABEL}. I won't let them down.

blunt.li: I'm {LABEL} now. Good. There's work to do.

cheerful.li: I'm the {LABEL}! I tried to look serious when they read it out. I don't think it worked.

gloomy.li: I'm {LABEL} now, so everything that goes wrong will be my fault.

cold.li: Elected {LABEL}. A useful position. I intend to use it.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: mastered a craft
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has spoken with a master's certainty since mastering {LABEL}.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} has mastered {LABEL}: there is nothing left anyone here could teach {PAWN_objective}.

plain.li: I've gone as far with {LABEL} as anyone can go. I thought it would feel like arriving. It feels like starting.
The others come to me now with questions about {LABEL}, and I have the answers. Most of them.
Years of {LABEL}, and today I did it without thinking at all. That's what it was for.

warm.li: I mastered {LABEL}. I'd like to teach someone. It's no good keeping it all in one head.

cheerful.li: Nobody in this colony is better at {LABEL} than me. I've checked. Twice.

gloomy.li: I've mastered {LABEL}. Nowhere left to go with it but down.

cold.li: My work in {LABEL} has reached its limit. Efficient. I'll find another field to improve.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: made a masterwork
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been prouder of {PAWN_possessive} work since making a masterwork {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: made a legendary piece
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has carried {PAWN_objective}self like a master since making a legendary {LABEL}.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} made a legendary {LABEL}, and knows it.

plain.li: I made a {LABEL} today that I'll never better. My hands were steadier than they've ever been.
The {LABEL} came off the bench and the room went quiet. People will remember who made it.
I keep going back to look at the {LABEL}. I'm not sure I made it so much as let it out.

warm.li: The {LABEL} is the best thing I'll ever make. I hope it goes to someone who'll love it.

blunt.li: Made a legendary {LABEL}. Back to work tomorrow.

cheerful.li: A legendary {LABEL}! By my own hands! I may need a lie down.

gloomy.li: That {LABEL} is the best I'll ever do. Everything after it will be a disappointment.

cold.li: The {LABEL} is flawless. I have finally met my own standards.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: raised a child
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has carried a settled kind of pride since {OTHER} grew up.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is grown. I keep wanting to tie {OTHER_possessive} boots for {OTHER_objective}.
I watched {OTHER_nameDef} walk off to work this morning like any grown-up. I had to sit down for a moment.
{OTHER_nameDef} asked my advice today, as one adult to another. I think I gave good advice.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has grown up kind. Whatever else I've done wrong, I did that right.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is all grown up and taller than me. When did that happen?

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is grown, and won't need me much now. That's how it's meant to go, I suppose.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} has reached adulthood capable and sound. A good outcome.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: became a parent
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been softer, and more careful, since {OTHER} was born.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is here. Small, loud and furious about everything. I'd die for {OTHER_objective} already.
I held {OTHER_nameDef} all afternoon and didn't notice the light go. I've never done that before.
I'm a parent. I keep checking that {OTHER_nameDef} is still breathing, every few minutes.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} grabbed my finger and wouldn't let go. Neither will I.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is the most beautiful thing in this colony and I will fight anyone who says otherwise.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef}, born into this. I'll do what I can to make it worth it.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} is born. I find I am not as detached as I expected.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: married
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has had someone to come home to since marrying {OTHER}.

plain.li: Married to {OTHER_nameDef}. I said my words without stumbling, which surprised us both.
{OTHER_nameDef} and I are married. I keep turning the word over. It fits better than I thought.
The wedding's done and the others have gone to bed. {OTHER_nameDef} is asleep beside me. Good day.

warm.li: I married {OTHER_nameDef} today. Whatever comes, we'll meet it together.

cheerful.li: I married {OTHER_nameDef}! There was dancing. I'm told I was the worst at it.

gloomy.li: Married {OTHER_nameDef}. Out here, I'd better make the most of every day of it.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} and I are married. A sensible arrangement, and I find I'm glad of it.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: saw a student through
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been glad to share what {PAWN_pronoun} knows since {OTHER} finished {PAWN_possessive} lessons.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: went hungry
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has never wasted a crumb since {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: a long illness
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has had more patience with the sick since a long bout of {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: overcame an addiction
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has trusted {PAWN_possessive} own will since getting free of {LABEL}.

plain.li: It's gone. The {LABEL} that had me by the throat is gone. I woke up this morning and didn't want it.
I'm free of {LABEL}. The shakes, the bad nights, the begging: all behind me now.
I walked past the drug shelf today and only noticed afterwards. That's how I know the {LABEL} is over.

warm.li: I beat the {LABEL}, with a lot of help. I'm going to thank every one of them.

cheerful.li: No more {LABEL}! I feel like I could carry a muffalo.

gloomy.li: Free of {LABEL}, for now. I'll keep watching myself.

cold.li: The {LABEL} has run its course. My judgement is my own again.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: enslaved
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has kept {PAWN_possessive} eyes down and {PAWN_possessive} thoughts to {PAWN_objective}self since being made a slave.

plain.li: They made me a slave today. I've decided not to give them the rest of me.
I'm a slave now. I can still think what I like, and I do.
Work, eat, sleep, work. Nobody asks what I want any more. I remember, though.

gloomy.li: So this is what the rest of my life looks like.

cold.li: My status has changed. My plans have not.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: freed
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has held {PAWN_possessive} head up since being freed on {LABEL}.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} is free, and walks like it.

plain.li: Free. I said it out loud three times in the empty storeroom, just to hear it.
I'm not a slave any more. My shoulders don't know what to do with themselves.
I'm free, and I've decided to stay. That's the first choice I've made in a long time.

warm.li: They freed me. I'll work twice as hard now, because now it's mine to give.

cheerful.li: I'm free! I walked the long way round to supper just because I could.

gloomy.li: Free, they say. I'll believe it when it's been a year.

cold.li: My freedom has been returned. I will not hand it back.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: took up a new faith
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has seen things through new eyes since taking up the ways of {LABEL}.

li.news: {PAWN_nameDef} has taken up the ways of {LABEL}.

plain.li: I hold to {LABEL} now. I didn't decide it so much as notice it had happened.
I've taken up the ways of {LABEL}. Some of the old prayers still come to me at night, out of habit.
Whatever I was before, I'm of {LABEL} now. The world looks the same, but it means something else.

warm.li: Those who keep {LABEL} took me in, and now their faith is mine too. It feels like coming home.

cheerful.li: I'm of {LABEL} now! There's so much I didn't know. I've been asking questions all day.

gloomy.li: I've given up the old faith for {LABEL}. I hope this one holds up better.

cold.li: The arguments of {LABEL} were better. I have changed my position accordingly.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: moved by a ceremony
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has held the colony's ways closer since the ceremony on {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: drawn to what lies beyond
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has wanted to know more about what lies past the world since what happened on {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: shaken by what lies beyond
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has looked over {PAWN_possessive} shoulder since what happened on {LABEL}.
